# Check Definitions

Check definitions are the statistics *digna* calculates and checks for a data source. Authentication, pagination and errors are described in the [Overview](index.md).

| Method | Path | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/v1/check-definitions` | [List check definitions](#get-check-definitions) |

---

## List check definitions {: #get-check-definitions }

```http
GET /v1/check-definitions
```

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `data_source_id` | query | integer | Yes | Filter by data source ID |
| `limit` | query | integer | No | Maximum number of rows to return (default: 200, max: 5000) |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | List check definitions | array of [CheckDefinition](#checkdefinition) |
| `400` | Invalid limit | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `401` | Not authenticated | [ApiError](#apierror) |
| `500` | Internal error | [ApiError](#apierror) |

**Example**

```bash
curl -X GET 'https://digna.example.com/v1/check-definitions?data_source_id=<data_source_id>' \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DIGNA_API_KEY"
```
